MatsukiyoCocokara & Co.
primarily sells over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, health supplements, and daily necessities through its large drugstore and insurance-dispensing pharmacy network. While they stock general home health monitoring tools (like blood pressure monitors or thermometers), they do not specialize in manufacturing or distributing advanced high-tech wearable medical devices (such as continuous glucose monitors or ECG patches).

Company Overview
Founding Year:
Traces its roots back to 1932 (formally incorporated as a holding structure in October 2007, and rebranded following the management integration of Matsumoto Kiyoshi and Cocokara Fine in October 2021).
マツキヨココカラ＆カンパニー
Headquarters:
Tokyo, Japan (with major corporate roots in Matsudo, Chiba).
What the Company Does:
Operates and manages an extensive retail chain of over 3,400 drugstores and health-insurance dispensing pharmacies, develops franchise businesses, and creates private-label health and beauty products.
